title: AgentHandoff
description: Visualize multi-agent delegation chains. Shows agent cards connected by handoff arrows, with status indicators and optional inline step display.

title: AgentStatusBar
description: Compact horizontal bar showing agent state plus optional metrics — tokens, elapsed time, cost, and model name. Only sections with data render.

title: AgentTimeline
description: A vertical timeline component for rendering AI agent workflows with real-time status updates, parallel execution tiers, and human-in-the-loop approval gates.

title: Connectors
description: Vertical lines drawn between steps to show sequential flow. AgentTimeline renders connectors automatically using CSS pseudo-elements — no extra components needed. The connector color follows each step

title: ContextBudget
description: Token budget meter showing context window usage. Visualizes input tokens, output tokens, system prompt, cache, and remaining capacity as a stacked bar or ring chart.

title: CostTracker
description: Running tally of API costs per model and per call. Shows a summary bar with total cost and model breakdowns, plus a detailed table of individual API calls.

title: DiffViewer
description: Unified or side-by-side code diff renderer. Renders `DiffFile` data with colored line backgrounds, line numbers, hunk headers, and file status badges.

title: PermissionBadges
description: Show what tools and permissions an agent has access to. Renders granted permissions with green check badges and denied permissions with red X badges.

title: StreamingText
description: Token-by-token text renderer with a blinking cursor. Shows LLM output as it arrives, with optional simulated typing animation for demos.

title: TaskTree
description: Nested tree of tasks and subtasks with status indicators, expand/collapse, and optional connector lines. Visualize how an agent decomposes work into hierarchical steps.

title: TerminalOutput
description: Streaming terminal/log output renderer with ANSI color support, auto-scroll, line numbers, and collapsible regions. Always renders with a dark terminal theme regardless of the app's color scheme.

title: ThinkingIndicator
description: Visual indicator for the "model is reasoning" phase — distinct from a loading spinner. Uses `useVisualMemory` for smooth enter/exit transitions.

title: TimelineApprovalGate
description: A human-in-the-loop approval prompt. Renders a title, optional description, and Approve/Reject buttons. Used by AgentTimeline when you pass the `approvalRequest` prop, or standalone for custom approva

title: TimelineArtifact

title: TimelineStep

title: TimelineSummary
description: Renders status count badges for a set of steps. Shows at a glance how many steps are complete, running, errored, or pending. Useful as a header or footer for your timeline.

title: TimelineTier
description: Groups multiple steps that execute in parallel. Renders them inside a bordered container with a header showing the tier label and a "N parallel" badge. Used by AgentTimeline when you pass the `tiers`

title: TimelineToolCall
description: Renders a single tool call with its name, status indicator, and optional expandable input/output details. Used inside TimelineStep when `showToolCalls` is enabled.

title: TimelineToolCallList
description: Renders a collapsible list of tool calls and artifacts for a step. Automatically expands when a tool call is in the `running` state. Used internally by TimelineStep when `showToolCalls` is enabled.

title: classNames
description: Every agent-native component accepts a `classNames` prop for targeted styling of internal elements.
